Randall Carlson and Graham Hancock appear together in this Joe Rogan Experience segment on lost technology and the Great Pyramids of Egypt. Carlson studies ancient floods and earth changes, while Hancock argues a skilled lost culture came before known history. Together they make the case that the pyramids hide a deeper past.

The two walk through the size, precision, and alignment of the pyramid stones. They ask how ancient builders cut and moved such blocks without modern machines. Rogan presses them on proof and on why experts reject their claims. The talk gives fringe ancient history its fullest hearing.
